SELECT
  LEFT(o.order_id, 10) AS order_id,
  COALESCE(oi_counts.number_of_items, 0) AS number_of_items,
  ABS(COALESCE(pays.total_price, 0)) AS total_price
FROM
  orders o
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    oi.order_id,
    COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS number_of_items
  FROM
    order_items oi
  GROUP BY
    oi.order_id
) oi_counts ON o.order_id = oi_counts.order_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    op.order_id,
    SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_price
  FROM
    order_payments op
  GROUP BY
    op.order_id
) pays ON o.order_id = pays.order_id;
